name: Best Practices
description: Swift and iOS development best practices

rules.name: No Force Unwrap
rules.message: Avoid force unwrapping (!), use optional binding or guard instead

rules.name: No Print Statements
rules.description: Use proper logging instead of print()
rules.message: Use Logger or os_log instead of print() for production code

rules.name: Mark TODO and FIXME
rules.description: Track technical debt with TODO/FIXME comments

rules.name: Async/Await Usage
rules.message: Consider using async/await instead of completion handlers

rules.name: MainActor Annotation
rules.message: ViewModels should be annotated with @MainActor for UI updates

rules.name: Sendable Conformance
rules.description: Types crossing actor boundaries should conform to Sendable
rules.message: Consider conforming to Sendable for types used in concurrent contexts

rules.name: Magic Numbers
rules.description: Avoid magic numbers, use named constants
rules.message: Consider extracting magic number to a named constant
